hero.headline: Sunset Agafay
hero.headline_2: Luxury Boutique Resort in Agafay Desert
hero.subline: Pool, accommodation, restaurant and exclusive experiences at the heart of Agafay Boutique Resort, only a few kilometres from Marrakech.

story.p1: Sunset Agafay is a Luxury Boutique Resort in Agafay Desert designed to offer a unique experience between desert, light and Moroccan hospitality. Nestled in the mineral landscapes of Agafay, our Agafay Boutique Resort invites you to slow down, reconnect, and live unforgettable moments around the pool, the sunset and exclusive desert experiences.
story.p2: Only minutes from Marrakech, Sunset Agafay blends contemporary elegance, nature and the Moroccan art of living in a refined, soothing atmosphere.

suites_section.title: Suites & Accommodation
suites_section.lede: Suites designed for comfort, calm and escape, inspired by the natural textures and the light of the Agafay desert.

rooms.name: Suite Agafay
rooms.brief: A warm suite opening onto the desert landscapes, with a private terrace and an ambience inspired by contemporary Berber style.

rooms.name: Suite Sunset
rooms.brief: Our signature suite, designed to enjoy the last rays of the sun in an intimate and refined atmosphere.

rooms.name: Suite Koutoubia
rooms.brief: An elegant suite combining Moroccan craftsmanship, natural light and modern comfort.

rooms.name: Family Suite
rooms.brief: A spacious setting designed to welcome families and groups wishing to share the Sunset Agafay experience together.

cinematic.quote: The desert here does not perform. It simply lasts longer than you do, and at six o'clock it lets the light go slowly enough that even hurried guests forget where they were going.

tables_section.title: Moroccan flavours & desert light
tables_section.lede: A refined culinary experience inspired by Moroccan and Mediterranean traditions, served in an elegant atmosphere at the heart of Agafay Boutique Resort.

tables.name: Le Souk Restaurant
tables.lede: Moroccan and Mediterranean cuisine, fresh produce and a warm ambience facing the sunset.
tables.copy: Moroccan and Mediterranean cuisine, fresh produce and a warm ambience facing the sunset. A menu that celebrates the flavours of Morocco and the Mediterranean, to be savoured on the terrace facing the Agafay dunes.

tables.name: Arish Bar
tables.lede: Signature cocktails, lounge music and a desert atmosphere under the stars.
tables.copy: Signature cocktails, lounge music and a desert atmosphere under the stars. The place for sunsets and long evenings, at the counter or out on the terrace.

tables.name: Private Dining
tables.lede: An intimate and exclusive gastronomic experience, ideal for special occasions and romantic dinners.
tables.copy: An intimate and exclusive gastronomic experience, ideal for special occasions and romantic dinners. Our team designs a bespoke menu and dedicated service, in a private setting for you and your guests.

experiences_section.title: Signature Experiences
experiences_section.lede: Live the desert differently through experiences designed for adventure, relaxation and emotion.

experiences.name: Camel Ride
experiences.lede: A camel ride through the unique landscapes of the Agafay desert at sunset.

experiences.name: Quad Experience
experiences.lede: Explore the desert trails with our guides for an unforgettable adventure.

experiences.name: Buggy Adventure
experiences.lede: Thrilling sensations and exceptional panoramas at the heart of the Agafay reliefs.

experiences.name: Sunset Dinner
experiences.lede: Dinner under the stars with live music, candles and refined Moroccan gastronomy.

experiences.name: Pool Day Pass
experiences.lede: Enjoy our pool and lounge areas for an exclusive day in the desert.

hammam_section.lede: Traditional hammam, relaxing massages and argan-oil treatments in a calm, soothing atmosphere inspired by the Agafay desert.

events_section.title: Events & Celebrations
events_section.lede: Weddings, birthdays, private parties or corporate events — Sunset Agafay welcomes your most precious moments in the exclusive setting of a Luxury Boutique Resort in Agafay Desert.

types.name: Wedding
types.lede: A kasbah wedding in a setting that requires no florist, no backdrop, no theme.
types.copy: We celebrate weddings for twelve or for eighty, managing every detail from the florals and lighting to the table plan and the last glass of champagne. The Agafay desert does the rest — no venue in Morocco has a more natural sense of occasion.

types.name: Private Gathering
types.lede: The kind of evening that has no programme and ends only when it should.
types.copy: Birthdays, anniversaries, intimate reunions, and milestone dinners. We set the long table, arrange the aperitif hour, order the flowers, and brief the kitchen. You choose the guest list and the hour; the desert provides everything else, including the light.

types.name: Corporate Retreat
types.lede: Exclusive use of the maison for the thinking that never happens in a conference room.
types.copy: Full buy-out of Sunset Agafay for leadership offsites, creative workshops, editorial shoots, and strategy sessions that require a change of scene. Complete F&B, private transfers from Marrakech-Menara, and a bespoke programme on request.

press_section.quote: One of those rare new openings that already feels as if it has always been there. The aperitif hour, especially, is a small masterpiece.

reviews_section.lede: A few notes left by guests, in their own words. We are quietly grateful.

items.quote: The light at six in the evening is something we still talk about. Camille and Idriss have built a place that feels older than it is — in the best possible way. We stayed three nights and rebooked from the airport.
items.name: Hélène & Mathieu

items.quote: Dinner at Le Souk under the pergola was the best meal we had in Morocco, and we ate well in Marrakech. The kitchen sends out small things you didn't ask for. The bar opens at six and the staff seem to know exactly when to leave you alone.
items.name: Sofia Marchetti

items.quote: We brought our two children, who were quickly absorbed into the courtyard like resident cats. The hammam ritual the night before we left was extraordinary — ninety minutes of quiet I haven't felt in years.
items.name: The Whitlock Family

items.quote: Booked for two nights to see the sunset and ended up extending twice. The pool catches the last of the afternoon, the Atlas turns pink, and someone brings you an aperitif without asking. A small miracle.
items.name: James & Rohan

faq_section.lede: A short list of the questions we are most often asked. Anything else, our team replies within twenty-four hours.

items.q: How do I get to Sunset Agafay from Marrakech?
items.a: We are 47 km south of Marrakech-Menara airport, roughly fifty minutes by road. We arrange private transfers in air-conditioned vehicles — day, night, or by the day for excursions. Most guests book a one-way airport transfer with their reservation; the road through the valley is part of the arrival.

items.q: What is included in the room rate?
items.a: A long breakfast under the pergola, all non-alcoholic refreshments throughout the day, late-afternoon mint tea and pastries at six, and the use of the pool, library, and courtyards. Wifi is included. Hammam treatments, dinner at Le Souk, and excursions are charged separately.

items.q: When is the best time of year to visit?
items.a: We are open all year. March through May and September through November are the most temperate. Summers are hot in the middle of the day but cool beautifully at sunset — the pool is well-used in July and August. Winters are bright and cold at night, with fires in the salons.

Yes — we welcome families, and the Family Suite is designed for two adults and two children. Children dine at Le Souk on a simplified menu and there is space to run in the courtyards. We are happy to arrange a sitter on request for parents wishing for a quiet dinner.

Of course. Chef Yassine will adapt to vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, and most allergies with twenty-four hours' notice. Please let us know when you reserve, and again when you arrive — we prefer to be told twice rather than not at all.

Reservations are fully refundable up to fourteen days before arrival. Within fourteen days, the first night is non-refundable. For high-season dates (Christmas, New Year, Easter) and for private events, separate terms apply and are communicated at the time of booking.

items.q: Can you host weddings or private events?
items.a: Yes. We host intimate weddings for twelve to eighty guests, milestone dinners, corporate retreats, and full buy-outs of the maison. The kasbah holds itself well as a backdrop. Please reach us via the contact form for a private consultation.

items.q: Is there parking and wifi on site?
items.a: Private parking is available within the kasbah walls at no charge. Wifi reaches every room and most of the gardens — we encourage you to use it sparingly. The desert is a good place to lose the signal on purpose.

transfers_page.hero_title: From the city to the desert.
transfers_page.hero_sub: Private, punctual, and arranged by the maison. Every transfer is handled personally — no third-party booking apps.

options.name: Airport Day Transfer
options.lede: A seamless morning or afternoon run from Marrakech-Menara to the kasbah gates.
options.copy: Our drivers meet you in arrivals with a name board. The route takes forty-five minutes on a clear day. Chilled water and wifi in the vehicle. Available 07:00 – 19:00.

options.name: Airport Night Transfer
options.lede: Late arrivals and early departures, handled quietly so the maison is never disturbed.
options.copy: For flights arriving or departing outside daylight hours. The same discreet service, with the added courtesy of a night-before confirmation. Available 19:00 – 07:00.

options.name: Private Transfer
options.lede: Bespoke road transfers to the medina, the coast, or wherever the day takes you.
options.copy: Use the vehicle for a half-day in the Marrakech souks, a trip to Essaouira, or an onward connection. Quoted individually by distance and hours. Minimum four-hour booking.

sunset_parties_page.hero_title: The hour when the desert performs.
sunset_parties_page.hero_sub: Three distinct formats, each built around the particular quality of Agafay light at dusk. A gathering, not an event.

parties.name: White Sunset Party
parties.lede: An all-white affair on the terrace as the sun drops behind the Atlas.
parties.copy: One request only: guests dress in white. The table is set in ivory linen and brass candleholders against the last hour of Agafay light. We open with an aperitif of Moroccan whites and cold mezze on the terrace; dinner is served by candlelight once the first stars appear. The evening runs 18:00 to midnight and is private hire only — no other guests on site.

parties.name: Pool Party
parties.lede: A long afternoon around the pool, with the Atlas as a permanent backdrop.
parties.copy: From noon until the sun disappears behind the dunes: shade cushions, cold Moroccan rosé, platters of mezze, and the particular quiet that a desert afternoon in forty degrees insists upon. Music from 16:00 — a resident DJ or live oud, your choice. The pool is reserved exclusively for your group. Runs noon to 20:00.

parties.name: Red Sunset Party
parties.lede: A curated cocktail gathering when the dunes turn deep ochre.
parties.copy: The most intimate of our three formats — held on the desert-facing terrace at the precise hour when the Agafay turns red. Pomegranate aperitifs, aged Moroccan reds, and warm mezze passed by hand. Strictly limited to twenty guests to preserve the atmosphere. Runs 18:30 to 22:00, all year round.
